description: Real-time CPU/GPU die thermals (IOHID), estimated wattage, RAM/Jetsam, floating Picture-in-Picture HUD, Dual-Probe ICMP/UDP/TCP network monitor, 24h SQLite history, and local PC/Mac web dashboard (:8787) for iPadOS & iOS.

apps.name: ArkDieHuD
apps.subtitle: Silicon & Network Telemetry HUD
apps.localizedDescription:
Monitor real Apple Silicon CPU & GPU die temperatures, wattage, RAM, and network packet loss (ICMP + UDP DNS 53 + TCP vs local router) in a customizable floating Picture-in-Picture HUD or on your PC/Mac browser (:8787).

Includes:
• 4 PiP layouts + 12 independent metric toggles
• Slide Over drawer for iPadOS
• Dual-Probe router vs ISP drop diagnosis & cycle detector
• 24h SQLite WAL history & unified CSV export
• Stealth PiP mode for voice-chat games
• Auto-detected English, Português (BR), and Español UI

versions.localizedDescription: Initial v1.0.0 release: trilingual auto-detection (EN/PT-BR/ES), persistent IOHID optimization (~3% single-core CPU, ~37 MiB RAM), Dual-Probe ICMP/UDP/TCP, 24h SQLite WAL logs, and PC/Mac web dashboard (:8787).

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Used to probe your local router and serve the live ArkDieHuD web dashboard to your PC or Mac browser.
